checklistName: Core Banking System IS Audit Checklist

items.item: Interest rate parameters verified against Board-approved rate card
items.observation: Interest rate master verified. Matches Board resolution dated April 2025.

items.item: Product masters (deposits, loans) configured as per policy
items.observation: All product parameters reviewed. Configuration aligns with product policy.

items.item: User privileges reviewed - segregation of duties maintained
items.observation: 2 users (userID: CBS-045, CBS-078) have both maker and checker access to GL module. Immediate remediation required.

items.item: Dormant/inactive user accounts disabled
items.observation: 8 inactive users (no login > 90 days) identified and disabled during audit.

items.item: Audit trail logging enabled for critical transactions
items.observation: Audit trail enabled for GL posting, rate changes, user creation/deletion.

items.item: Password policy enforced (complexity, expiry, history)
items.observation: Password policy: min 8 chars, alphanumeric, expiry 90 days, 5 password history.

items.item: Batch processing monitored and exceptions reviewed
items.observation: Daily EOD batch logs reviewed. Exception reports generated and reviewed by IT team.

items.item: Change management process followed for CBS patches/upgrades
items.observation: Last 3 patches (10.2.13 to 10.2.15) had documented change requests, UAT, and rollback plans.

items.item: Database backup and recovery tested
items.observation: Daily incremental, weekly full backup. Quarterly restore test successful (last: Dec 2025).

items.item: Vendor support contract active and SLA compliance monitored
items.observation: Infosys AMC valid till March 2027. SLA: 99.5% uptime achieved in 2025.

checklistName: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery Audit Checklist

items.item: BCP/DR policy approved by Board and reviewed annually
items.observation: BCP/DR Policy v2.0 approved Oct 2024. Next review due Oct 2025.

items.item: Recovery Time Objective (RTO) defined and achievable
items.observation: RTO: 4 hours for CBS. DR drill achieved RTO in 3.5 hours (Dec 2025 drill).

items.item: Recovery Point Objective (RPO) defined and backup frequency aligned
items.observation: RPO: 24 hours. Daily backup schedule supports RPO requirement.

items.item: DR site infrastructure adequate and tested quarterly
items.observation: DR site at Nashik (80 km from HO). Last DR drill: Dec 15, 2025. CBS failover successful.

items.item: Crisis Management Team (CMT) identified and trained
items.observation: CMT has 7 members (CEO, CIO, CFO, CAE, Branch Heads). Annual BCP training conducted Nov 2025.

items.item: Communication plan for stakeholders (staff, customers, regulators) documented
items.observation: Communication templates available. Contact lists updated quarterly.

items.item: Offsite backup storage secured and accessible
items.observation: Backup tapes stored at DR site (Nashik). Monthly verification of tape integrity.

items.item: Cyber incident response plan documented and tested
items.observation: Cyber incident response plan exists. However, no cyber drill conducted since 2024. Tabletop exercise recommended.

items.item: Firewall configured and logs reviewed regularly
items.observation: Cisco ASA firewall. Logs reviewed weekly by IT security team. Intrusion attempts blocked and logged.

items.item: Intrusion Detection System (IDS) deployed and monitored
items.observation: Snort IDS deployed at perimeter. Alerts forwarded to IT team. Monthly IDS report generated.

items.item: Vulnerability scanning conducted quarterly
items.observation: Last vulnerability scan: Nov 2025. 3 medium vulnerabilities identified and patched.

items.item: Patch management process for critical systems
items.observation: Critical patches applied within 7 days. Non-critical patches within 30 days. Patch log maintained.

items.item: Access control review (privileged accounts, VPN, remote access)
items.observation: VPN access logs reviewed. However, 3 privileged accounts (root, admin) have not changed passwords in 180+ days.

items.item: Email security (spam filter, phishing protection) configured
items.observation: Google Workspace spam filter active. Phishing simulation conducted Oct 2025 - 15% click rate.

items.item: Data encryption for sensitive data (at rest and in transit)
items.observation: Database encryption enabled (TDE). HTTPS/TLS enforced for all web applications.

items.item: Security awareness training for all staff
items.observation: Annual cyber security training conducted Sep 2025. 98% staff attendance. E-learning module deployed.

items.item: Cyber insurance policy active
items.observation: Cyber insurance policy with HDFC Ergo. Coverage: ₹5 Cr. Valid till June 2026.

items.item: Compliance with RBI Cyber Security Framework
items.observation: Most controls implemented. Gap: SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) not yet deployed. Planned for Q2 2026.
